scenario.name: r-cd-4-target-session-key
scenario.description: continue_delegate with targetSessionKey: delegate return lands in a SPECIFIED target session, not the dispatching session. Cross-session targeted delivery.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: reply with TARGET-RECEIVED and the nonce. Do not mutate files.

expectedReceipts.name: task-ledger-entry
expectedReceipts.description: Optional extra context only; target-session proof must use subscribed session events rather than the generic TaskFlow task ledger

expectedReceipts.name: return-lands-in-target
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return arrives in the TARGET session (not the dispatching session)

expectedReceipts.name: no-return-to-parent
expectedReceipts.description: Dispatching session does NOT receive the return (delivery went to target)

review.notes: Cross-session targeted return. PASS-candidate when: (1) dispatch accepted with targetSessionKey, (2) return lands in TARGET session, (3) dispatching session does NOT receive the return. A nonce-correlated tasks.list row is optional because continue_delegate uses pending-delegate/subagent surfaces, not the generic task registry.
